response.overview: Hank Krinkle is a socially isolated content moderator who spends his days policing the most depraved corners of the internet while caring for his abusive, dying father. When Hank’s desperate search for a black-market kidney draws him into an underground world of sex work, conspiracy and algorithmic manipulation, the boundaries between the digital world and reality begin to collapse. As Hank becomes increasingly entangled in this hidden network, his grip on the real world starts to unravel.
response.title: Non-Player Character
